$comment: The one public source for /projects/. Rendered at build time by scripts/projects.mjs. Curated public summaries only.

projects.name: A Knew Knowledge
projects.summary: The umbrella for everything here: the book, this website, the community and the AKnewSuite of tools that run on their own and are driven by voice.
projects.note: Ideas for funding and commercializing the company are listed separately and not started.

projects.name: AKnewScribe
projects.summary: Records and transcribes voice notes and conversations, then keeps them searchable with sources so nothing said is lost. A new version on the shared AKnew SDK is in progress.

projects.name: Ultimate Notes
projects.summary: A notes layer for AKnewScribe that would pull in old notes from other apps and drives and turn them into one organized, searchable notebook.
aliases: Keep, OneNote and Samsung Notes import
projects.note: Partly started; mostly still an idea.

projects.name: 24-hour audio log
projects.summary: An all-day audio log for AKnewScribe that strips out silence so a full day can be reviewed quickly.

projects.name: Truth check
projects.summary: Marks where every remembered fact came from and flags old notes as dated, so recall never passes off stale information as current.

projects.name: Follow-through ledger
projects.summary: Tracks every promise and "look into this" request so it is actually done, not just acknowledged.

projects.name: Telegram call capture
projects.summary: Captures live Telegram calls into AKnewScribe so they are transcribed like any other conversation.

projects.name: Sealed Scribe backups
projects.summary: Encrypted cloud backups for AKnewScribe recordings, with a practiced restore drill so a backup is proven before it is needed.

projects.name: AKnewRecollection
projects.summary: A search plugin that answers "do you recall" questions from AKnewScribe records and always cites where the answer came from.

projects.name: AKnewRecall
projects.summary: Ask AKnewScribe questions from Discord and get cited answers from past notes and recordings.

projects.name: AKnew Voice
projects.summary: Hands-free, real-time voice conversation with the assistant, so everything can be done by speaking.
projects.note: Tested with synthetic speech; real-world use is early.

projects.name: aKnewMod
projects.summary: An AI moderator and admin for the A Knew Knowledge Discord server that carries out requested server changes safely.

projects.name: Discord project workspaces

projects.name: aKnewKanban
projects.summary: Mirrors the work board into Discord so tasks can be followed and steered from a phone.

projects.name: aKnewReady
projects.summary: A ready-to-test board plus the #demos showcase, where finished things wait to be tried.
projects.note: Partly built; the demos showcase is public.

projects.name: Update Me
projects.summary: A Discord channel that answers "what is new" with a short, current summary of every project.

projects.name: aKnewError
projects.summary: Collects errors and failures from every tool into one place so they are noticed and fixed quickly.

projects.name: aKnewWatcher
projects.summary: Watches for urgent problems and raises them right away; part of aKnewError.

projects.name: Failure alerts
projects.summary: Sends a Telegram alert when an automated job fails; part of aKnewError.

projects.name: aKnewQuota
projects.summary: Shows how much AI usage is left across subscriptions, with a /quota command and usage history.

projects.name: Desktop quota display

projects.summary: Spreads AI work across the owner's own subscriptions by remaining headroom so work keeps moving.

projects.name: aKnewBroker

projects.note: The standalone bot is blocked; the hub is partly built.

projects.summary: Turns a spoken idea into a planned, built and tested app with little hands-on work: an autonomous app factory.

projects.name: aKnewFactory

projects.name: AKnewWorkFlow
projects.summary: Collects new ideas from Discord and Telegram and files them into the pipeline.
projects.note: Paused; recovery of the intake is planned.
